description: Calendar appointments with invitees, type and outcome. Filter by person, user, or a start+end window (both required together). FUB: GET /v1/appointments.

end.description: Window end (ISO-8601). Must be combined with start.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

personId.description: Person id, or a comma-separated list of ids.

start.description: Window start (ISO-8601). Must be combined with end.

name: fub_list_appointments
title: List appointments
